about: The recorded reading per rung (council round 2026-11-04-rungs). Each row is one reading: the rung it witnesses, the witness class and reader, the time (the step stamp, the client's local clock), the artifact with the SHA256 its report's MANIFEST lists, the context it was taken in, the operating point (value) and what was observed. packages/triad-369/src/rung_ledger.mjs turns the rows into verdicts; tools/rung-ledger.test.mjs makes the addon's constants answer to them. A value moves only when a counted reading moves it.

conventions.fit.observed: top and bottom: the gaps from the red frame's top and bottom edges to the model's outermost part (twigs and stems included, not only the dense leaves), as fractions of the frame height; 'touches' when the model reaches that edge and whether it is cut there cannot be seen, 'clipped' when it visibly runs past it, 'hidden' when something covers it. topBound and bottomBound: with that edge hidden, the largest gap the visible part allows (the model reaches at least that far). width: the model's width as a fraction of the frame width, or 'overflow'. fill: a first reading that recorded only how much of the frame the model fills.
conventions.coverage: every camera-distance fit shot in the nine reports has a second reading (35 shots). The two model-scale shots of the fifth report (WoWScrnShot_110426_112707 and 112755) are not fit readings: they vary SetModelScale at the default camera, not the camera factor a fit is. The tenth report adds a twin reading of each fit pair it holds (the jar's pair was overwritten, the canopy04 step drew the barrel) and five projection readings of its step-1 twin. The tenth report adds a twin reading of each fit pair it holds (the jar's pair was overwritten, the canopy04 step drew the barrel) and five projection readings of its step-1 twin.
conventions.decisive: a reading passes only when its residual plus its precision is within the tolerance, and fails only when its residual minus its precision is outside it; a reading nearer the tolerance than its own precision decides nothing
conventions.precision: about half a tick of the reading grid: 0.03 on a marked frame, 0.05 on the known rectangle; 0.1 for a first reading by eye

readers.first reading, when the report landed: the director, reading the owner's screenshots when each report landed (by eye, the whole picture)
readers.second reading, grid crop, round 6: the director, re-reading every fit shot in round 6 against crops with a tick every 5% (tools/frame_fill.py sheet) and 1% zooms; the bush and tree tops corrected after the round's review re-read them brightened
readers.twin reading, round 7: the director, reading the tenth report's overlay-off twins (owner ruling 1: the real objects read before any prediction was opened; fits with tools/frame_fill.py twin and a brightened crop for every flagged edge)

witness classes.host: a host API read (UnitPosition and the tile lookup, GetModelFileID), captured by the owner's panel
witness classes.owner: the owner's own word or saved value (a /fide terrain test fit press)
witness classes.director: the director's reading of the owner's screenshot (owner ruling 1 decides whether it counts)
witness classes.client-visible: the frame's own IsVisible: an echo

conventions.time: the step stamp the panel records (date(), the client's local clock); never a file time and never the report-level at
conventions.projection.observed: residual: the distance from the predicted foot (the camera in use, through EMatrix_Math.BuildCamera and ProjectPoint, or its replica, which reproduces every recorded foot) to the foot read blind in an overlay-off twin, over the placement's projected height; foot, predicted and height in UI units from the bottom left; the context names the camera in use (pitch, fovY) so a confirmed change unlocks the old readings
conventions.subject: what in the artifact a reading is of (a placement in a scene shot): two subjects read in one shot are two readings; the evaluator supersedes only readings of the same artifact, line, subject, witness class and value

projection:abbey-door.command: /fide terrain pitch 12.8 confirm and /fide terrain fov 53.8 confirm
projection:abbey-door.rule: pitch and fovY fitted by weighted least squares (Levenberg-Marquardt) on the blind feet of every named placement but the held-out one, each weighted by its reading precision and its origin uncertainty; zoom frozen at its read (4.55); a yaw offset freed only if the horizontal residual fails (freed as a check, it fitted 0.0000 rad)

heldOut.label: G
heldOut.why: chosen before any fitted residual was computed (the sharpest trunk base, the smallest precision over its height); it misses by 19 px sideways while F, the same model 42 px away, lands within 2 px, so no camera parameter can close it: a local offset (its origin, or the blind reading: a colour profile read after unsealing puts the trunk 6 px right of the blind reading, 0.083 of its height, which still does not pass and does not count)

projection:abbey-door.status: not confirmed: the held-out residual 0.121 exceeds the tolerance by more than its precision; printed as an ask, applied only by the owner's confirmed command (owner ruling 4)
projection:abbey-door.script: docs/council/2026-11-04-rungs/judge/fit10.py (blind10.json holds the readings frozen before unsealing)
